title: Supporting Calibrated Reliance in Human-AI Collaboration: Different Strategies for Different Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2604.03237v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As AI systems increasingly support human decision making, a central challenge is determining what information helps people recognize when to rely on AI predictions and when to question or override them. Across three controlled human-subject studies spanning abstract visual reasoning with RAVEN matrices and deductive logical reasoning with LSAT problems, we examine how different forms of AI support affect human--AI team performance. A multi-stage reveal study shows that AI predictions and explanations can affect objective accuracy and subjective confidence differently. In visual reasoning, LLM explanations do not improve accuracy beyond the predicted answer alone, and no additional support format significantly outperforms prediction-only support; predicted probabilities show the highest descriptive accuracy and error recovery, while a derived selective-automation policy provides a higher-performing reference benchmark. translated_title: 支持人机协作中的校准依赖：不同任务采用不同策略
translated_abstract: 随着人工智能系统越来越多地支持人类决策，一个核心挑战是确定哪些信息能帮助人们认识到何时应依赖AI预测，以及何时应质疑或推翻它们。通过三项受控的人类受试者研究，涵盖使用RAVEN矩阵的抽象视觉推理和使用LSAT问题的演绎逻辑推理，我们考察了不同形式的AI支持如何影响人机团队的表现。一项多阶段逐步揭示的研究表明，AI预测和解释可以分别影响客观准确性和主观信心。在视觉推理中，大语言模型（LLM）的解释并未在仅提供预测答案的基础上提升准确性，且没有额外的支持格式显著优于仅预测支持；预测概率在描述性准确性和错误恢复方面表现最佳，而一种衍生的选择性自动化策略则提供了更高性能的参考基准。在语言任务中，我们发现不同的支持策略对校准依赖具有差异化影响，强调了任务类型在决定有效支持方式中的关键作用。
tldr: 本文通过实验发现，AI支持形式（如预测、解释、概率）对人机协作中的校准依赖影响因任务类型而异，视觉推理中预测概率最有效，而解释并非总是提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper experimentally shows that the effectiveness of AI support formats (e.g., predictions, explanations, probabilities) on calibrated reliance in human-AI collaboration varies by task type, with predicted probabilities most effective in visual reasoning and explanations not always improving performance.
